explication: Terrain Diffusion MC is a Fabric mod that generates Minecraft terrain from diffusion-model outputs and exposes a local web explorer. The main path is world creation and scale selection, Minecraft biome/density requests, cached terrain retrieval, then tiled model inference and height/biome conversion; spawn search is a separate startup behavior. README also documents explorer controls, configuration, and model downloads. Edges follow the README or shown source references/calls; unsampled internals are represented without asserting unverified links.
